typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Db_CAE_RPT_UTIL as string (),
	Id_CAE_RPT_UTIL as string (),
	Pw_CAE_RPT_UTIL as string (),
	Src_CAE_RPT_UTIL as string (),
	v_current_date as timestamp (),
	v_file_name as string (),
	v_file_url as string (),
	v_isFileExists as boolean (),
	v_out_folder as string (),
	v_tbl_sheet_script as string ()
}

source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string,
		FIRST_NAME as string,
		LAST_NAME as string,
		CONTACT_TYPE as string,
		STREET as string,
		CITY as string,
		STATE as string,
		ZIP as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'APP_RPTS.PR_CAE_NJ_TTRY_POSTCARD \'\' WITH RESULT SETS (  (   SBSB_ID varchar(9),  FIRST_NAME varchar(15),  LAST_NAME varchar(35),  CONTACT_TYPE varchar(10),  STREET Nvarchar(100) ,  CITY Nvarchar(50) ,  [STATE] Nvarchar(2),  ZIP Nvarchar(10)  )  )',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of SBSB_ID} = toString(SBSB_ID),
		{Copy of STREET} = STREET,
		{Copy of STATE} = STATE,
		{Copy of FIRST_NAME} = toString(FIRST_NAME),
		{Copy of CONTACT_TYPE} = toString(CONTACT_TYPE),
		{Copy of LAST_NAME} = toString(LAST_NAME),
		{Copy of CITY} = CITY,
		{Copy of ZIP} = ZIP) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of ZIP} as string,
		{Copy of STREET} as string,
		{Copy of CONTACT_TYPE} as string,
		{Copy of FIRST_NAME} as string,
		{Copy of STATE} as string,
		{Copy of SBSB_ID} as string,
		{Copy of LAST_NAME} as string,
		{Copy of CITY} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
